recap.analyst:
Ridgeview and Harbor City drew 1-1. On expected goals it finished 0.34–0.56: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Harbor City had 58% of the ball. Pass completion RID 77% (109/141), HAR 84% (192/228). Shots 2–5, on target 1–1.

Ridgeview started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Harbor City in a 4-3-3 (balanced). Neither coach changed shape.

Turning point, 58': Harbor City levelled the match through P. Reyes. The chance was worth xG 0.13 (about 13 in 100 go in), struck at 95 km/h. Score now RID 1-1 HAR.

By the numbers: Y. Yeboah completed the most passes (40); T. Arbeloa hit the top speed (33.4 km/h); T. Arbeloa covered the most ground (6.24 km, a 17.5 km per-90 pace); T. Arbeloa won the most challenges (14).

Discipline: fouls 1–1, yellows 0–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: sunny, 27°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Castellana Arena, Madrid. P. Petit broke the deadlock in the 32nd minute. P. Reyes struck in the 58th for Harbor City. Harbor City had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: P. Petit, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
